answer: The crystal I would price into every new account is Proof of unique emergency contact: a contact who answers when called, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. What makes this stick is that a contact who answers when called cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the delta of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the orchard for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
